custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin who can switch between two locations: the test location and location B.
  • Create part A for this test at the test location and at location B, and change its part number once at the test location, so location B's Part History has a long entry ending with Changed at.
  • Make sure the app is in the Light theme.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1600 pixels wide with the page zoom at 100%, so the screen is as wide as the design boards.
  • Open the attached design pictures of boards 2.4 and 2.6 at 100% zoom, so you can compare the screen with them.
  • Start on the test location's Inventory page, on the Active tab.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Location B is Staging Lethbridge - 4310. To switch: click the box at the top right, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Lethbridge - 4310. Switch back to Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 the same way.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839486-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839486-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
  • Theme: click your avatar (the AS circle) at the top right; Light and Dark are at the bottom of its menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A is listed.

Step 2:

  • The test location's Part History shows the "Part number updated" entry, with no "Changed at" at its end.

Step 3:

  • The location selector shows location B.

Step 4:

  • The Parts left menu shows Inventory.

Step 5:

  • Location B's Inventory page opens on the Active tab.

Step 6:

  • Part A is listed at location B under its new part number.

Step 7:

  • The Staff, Date and Time columns are as wide as on the test location's Part History page (compare with board 2.4).
  • The "Part number updated | Original number: … | New number: … | Changed at: …" entry wraps onto a second line inside the Event column.
  • No column narrows, and the end of the entry, the test location's name, is readable: it is not cut off with "...".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 35 (edited 27 Oct 2026 by Chris Ward), read 28 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change)

  • S10-R21: “The Part History table keeps its column layout whatever an entry says. A short entry does not widen the Staff, Date or Time columns. A long entry wraps onto more lines within its column and is never cut short.”
  • S10-R25: “On the entries written at the other locations, the line ends with "| Changed at: {location}", naming the location where the change was made.”

From: Product's answers to questions 13 to 27 (Chris Ward, 27 Oct 2026, Google Doc https://docs.google.com/document/d/1pkAPGqWVTdtYorNN4SVNl9HkHxuuB9czro_y2DbUeEM/edit, saved word for word in full-pass-2026-10-27/ANSWERS-13-27-2026-10-27.md), read 28 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward, 27 Oct 2026, answer 21: “(a) It wraps onto more lines, as on board 2.6. The full entry always shows and is never cut short (S10-R21).”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.

References from Design

Design canvas "Parts Lifecycle Update" (https://claude.ai/artifact/Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE), 13 Oct 2026 copy, unchanged when re-read on 27 Oct 2026: boards "2.4 Part History at Heavy Duty", "2.6 Part History at Lethbridge". Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the quotes above where the PRD speaks, and from the board pictures where it is silent about the look.

Board 2.6 redraws the table over the build screenshot and its note says a long Event wraps onto a second line. Product ruled on 27 Oct 2026 (answer 21) that a long entry wraps and is never cut short, and PRD v35 (S10-R21) now says so; the tech plan's ellipsis is overruled. Compare with the attached redrawn table, not with the board's raw screenshot.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • correct-04-p2-4-history-here.png
  • board-2.6-part-history-at-lethbridge-redrawn-table.png

The design's own words:

  • “The entries are written at Lethbridge too. They end with "| Changed at: Staging Heavy Duty - 9919", naming the location where the change was made (S10-R25). Staff, Date and Time keep their production widths; a long Event wraps onto a second line. This board's table is redrawn over the build screenshot. The build still narrows Staff, Date and Time when the Event lines are long; that needs fixing to match.”
